title: Biological neuron models: integrate-and-fire and synapses
summary: Neuromatch W2D4: the leaky integrate-and-fire neuron under stochastic input, the effects of input correlation on output spiking, models of static and dynamic synapses, and the bonus material on spike-timing-dependent plasticity; the mechanistic ('how') thread of unit 1 continued.

objectives.description: Objectives for this unit will be finalised when it is prepared; the source material is Neuromatch W2D4 (Tutorials 1–3 and the bonus STDP tutorial), building on the W1D1 'how' tutorial already verified.

preparation.description: W2D4 Biological Neuron Models chapter page: Tutorial 1 The Leaky Integrate-and-Fire Neuron Model, Tutorial 2 Effects of Input Correlation, Tutorial 3 Synaptic transmission (static and dynamic synapses), bonus Tutorial 4 Spike-timing dependent plasticity.
Re-read W1D1 Tutorial 2 ('How' models) for the integrate-and-fire model with Poisson inputs, which this unit extends.
